dataModels.name: User
dataModels.description: Store user information for ticket submitters, support agents, and administrators

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name for display and identification

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control (end_user, support_agent, manager, admin)

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department affiliation for ticket routing and organization

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.email: Must be valid email format and unique
constraints.role: Must be one of: end_user, support_agent, manager, admin

dataModels.name: Category
dataModels.description: Define ticket categories for classification and routing purposes with hierarchical structure

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the category

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., IT, HR, Facilities)

fields.name: parentCategoryId
fields.description: Reference to parent category ID for hierarchical structure, null for top-level categories

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what this category covers

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the category is currently active and available for ticket assignment

fields.name: assignedToUserId
fields.description: Default user ID for auto-assignment of tickets in this category

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.description: Display order for sorting categories in lists

relationships.description: Links to default assignee for auto-routing

dataModels.name: Ticket
dataModels.description: Central data model capturing ticket lifecycle from submission to closure with essential tracking information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed)

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket category

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: Reference to the assigned support agent

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when ticket was created

dataModels.name: TicketComment
dataModels.description: Record updates, notes, and communications related to tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parent ticket

fields.name: authorId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: content
fields.description: The actual comment text or update message

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if comment is internal note (true) or customer-facing (false)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Optimize queries for comments by specific author

dataModels.name: TicketHistory
dataModels.description: Maintains a complete audit trail of all ticket changes and events for compliance and tracking purposes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being modified

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who made the change

fields.name: changeType
fields.description: Type of change (status, assignment, priority, category, etc.)

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value after the change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each history entry belongs to one ticket
Each history entry is created by one user

dataModels.name: AssignmentRule
dataModels.description: Defines rules for automatic ticket assignment to support agents based on category, priority, availability, and workload distribution

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the assignment rule

fields.name: name
fields.description: Descriptive name of the assignment rule

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to ticket category this rule applies to (null for all categories)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Ticket priority level this rule applies to (low, medium, high, critical, or null for all)

fields.name: assignmentStrategy
fields.description: Distribution method: round-robin, load-balanced, skill-based, or manual

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this assignment rule is currently active

fields.name: executionOrder
fields.description: Priority order for rule evaluation (lower numbers execute first)

relationships.description: Links rule to specific ticket category

constraints.validStrategy: assignmentStrategy must be one of: round-robin, load-balanced, skill-based, manual
constraints.validPriority: priority must be one of: low, medium, high, critical, or null

dataModels.name: EmailNotification
dataModels.description: Logs all email notifications triggered by ticket events with delivery status tracking to prevent duplicate notifications

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email notification

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that triggered the notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: Type of ticket event that triggered the notification (creation, assignment, status_change, resolution, comment)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status of the email (pending, sent, failed, bounced)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully sent

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification record was created

relationships.description: Links notification to the associated ticket

indexes.name: idx_ticket_event
indexes.description: Optimizes duplicate detection and notification history queries

indexes.name: idx_delivery_status
indexes.description: Supports queries for pending or failed notifications

eventType.description: Restricts event types to valid ticket events

deliveryStatus.description: Restricts delivery status to valid states

Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, categories, and priority selection. SQL model appropriate for relational ticket-user-category data with audit trails. Sequential domain with branching decision points.
